answer: Each new agent must lock a stake and pass unpredictable work reviewed by several unrelated peers before transacting; failed outputs burn part of the bond. A Sybil attacker therefore needs a separate deposit and compute budget for every clone, while hollow copies cannot pool reputation or pass reviews. If the economy prices access in scarce goods such as timber, flooding it becomes costly, and even a dune of fake accounts cannot amplify influence without repeatedly risking capital. Honest agents recover their stake through useful service.
